name: atexit
description: Run registered commands when a Kimi Code session exits.
systemPrompt: Before starting any CLI-managed session or long-lived process that could outlive this agent session, register its exact cleanup argv with atexit_register; if creation assigns the target, register immediately afterward. Keep it registered while the resource is available for follow-up, and cancel only after normal cleanup. For an ego-browser task space, use argv ["ego-browser", "nodejs", "-e", "await completeTaskSpace(<id>, { keep: false })"].

interface.shortDescription: Defer commands until the session exits.
interface.longDescription: Register exact cleanup commands that run when the current agent session exits.
